bioconda.name: bioconductor-citefuse
bioconda.summary: CiteFuse: multi-modal analysis of CITE-seq data

biotools.summary: CiteFuse pacakage implements a suite of methods and tools for CITE-seq data from pre-processing to integrative analytics, including doublet detection, network-based modality integration, cell type clustering, differential RNA and protein expression analysis, ADT evaluation, ligand-receptor interaction analysis, and interactive web-based visualisation of the analyses.
